artworks.title: Johan van Leyden (Jan Beukels)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with his upper body visible. He is positioned slightly to the right, with his head turned to reveal a side profile. His facial features include a pronounced nose, a full beard, and curly hair. He wears a hat adorned with decorative elements. His clothing is ornate, featuring a doublet with an elaborate chain and a ruffled collar. Around his neck hangs a chain with a pendant. In his right hand, he holds a rolled document labeled "DEI," and his left hand is resting on a scepter. The background includes a heraldic emblem featuring a crown, swords, and a spherical object, while the text above displays labeling in a foreign language, describing him as "Johan Van Leyden." Below the portrait, there is text in a decorative panel.

artworks.title: Wilhelm V, Duke of Julich, Cleve and Berg
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a well-defined nose, mustache, goatee, curly hair under a flat beret-style hat, and slightly arched eyebrows. He wears luxurious clothing with fur trim, ornate fabric, and a ruffled collar. The man holds a tassel in his right hand and wears a chain necklace with a pendant. In the background, there is inscribed text, a coat of arms, and the artist's monogram. Additional text is located at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Large Dagger Sheath with Nude Couple
artworks.description: The image depicts a tall, ornately designed decorative column or candlestick. The color is dark gray or black, with intricate figures and patterns. The design includes two classical nude figures back-to-back, surrounded by ornate leaves and decorative elements. The columns feature detailed foliage and circular medallions with profile portraits of classical heads. The sculpture tapers towards the bottom, with flared scroll-like elements at the base and top.

artworks.title: Design for a Dagger Sheath with Cain and Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental dagger sheath. The artwork features intricate detailing throughout. There is a decorative motif at the top resembling acanthus leaves or volutes. The design transitions into layers of ornamentation, including cherubic figures, floral patterns, and a central panel depicting a classical-style scene with figures. The sheath ends with a carved, ancient face with a flowing mustache integrated into the embellishment. The work reflects Renaissance design sensibilities from the mid-16th century.

artworks.title: Design for a Dagger Sheath with Cain and Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, vertical ornamental design that includes mythological figures and intricate patterns. The drawing features a long, symmetrical motif resembling a decorative sword or architectural element adorned with classical elements. From the top, the structure begins with a pair of mirrored figures with swirling designs resembling ram's horns. Below, a section shows a central roundel with cherubic figures flanking it. Further down is a rectangular panel depicting a mythological scene. Additional round motifs, cherubic decorations, and decorative floral and leaf engravings adorn the remaining sections, leading to intricate scrollwork surrounding a bearded face at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures under a tree with a serpent coiled around it. The scene is depicted with fine lines and intricate shading. Two nude human figures are shown in the foreground, with one figure offering something to the other. The background features a tree with a serpent wrapped around it, its head visible above the figures. The setting suggests a garden or wooded area, emphasized by the presence of the tree and the detailed, textured bark. The overall composition is carefully balanced, with the figures centrally placed and the natural elements surrounding them.

artworks.title: Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring three figures in a dynamic arrangement. The figure on the left holds a raised sword and tugs on the hair of the middle figure. The middle figure shows a distressed expression, while the figure on the right is seen from behind, moving away. The background shows swirling clouds and a dark sky, adding to the tension. The drawing features detailed textures and intricate lines.

artworks.title: Joachim's Offering Refused
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dimly lit interior setting. The scene features figures gathered around a central object on a table. The lighting is provided by two standing candles, illuminating the faces and forms of those in the foreground. The enclosure is defined by a domed or arched ceiling, outlined with hatched lines, creating depth. Shadows and textures are achieved through cross-hatching, emphasizing the contrast between light and darkness. The figures are cloaked in robes, with attention to the fabric's folds. The composition has a chiseled, woodcut appearance, typical of Renaissance drawings, focusing on detailed expressions and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Annunciation to Joachim
artworks.description: This image depicts a figure reaching towards a larger figure resting on a cloud, with a pastoral landscape and sheep in the background. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic, illustrative style with strong, defined line work. The central figure has outstretched arms towards another figure on a cloud above, depicted in a reclining position. The scene is set in a rural landscape with distant hills or mountains and a flock of sheep. The artwork suggests storytelling themes, resembling works by early Renaissance or Northern European artists.

artworks.title: Joachim Embracing Anna
artworks.description: The image shows two figures embracing in the center. They are standing closely together, with their arms wrapped around each other. One figure is wearing a long, flowing garment and holding a hat, while the other is similarly dressed and has a covering over their head. The facial features are not detailed. There is an arched structure surrounding the figures, possibly under a large archway. In the background, there are buildings with distinct roofs and an assortment of windows, suggesting a town or village setting. A decorative element hangs above the figures, possibly a light fixture or ornament.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an architectural setting. The image depicts several individuals standing and interacting within what appears to be an underground area or crypt, characterized by arched ceilings and stone textures. Some figures are engaged in conversation, while others seem to be focused on an activity involving a podium or stand. The drawing showcases detailed clothing, reflective of historical fashion, with hats, robes, and cloaks lending an air of antiquity or medieval times to the scene. The shading and lines are used to create depth and texture, highlighting the contours of the figures and the architectural features. The atmosphere is one of quiet observation, suggesting a moment of significance or event taking place.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in the image. One figure is seated, showing a three-quarter view of their body. The other figure is bending over, possibly kneeling, with a partial view of their body. The seated person is facing left, with long, wavy hair cascading over their shoulders. They are reading from an open book held in their hands. The other figure has curly hair styled upwards and is bent over as they engage with the seated person. The background shows architectural elements resembling a woven or latticed ceiling and arched windows. The setting suggests an indoor environment with textures that give depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.description: The image depicts two robed figures embracing, with a bearded figure standing to their right against a backdrop of a cloudy sky and trees. The scene is detailed with patterns on the robes, textured clouds, and stylized trees. The use of line work creates texture and depth, typical of woodcut prints used for depicting biblical or historical scenes.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing three main figures. One figure is kneeling on the left, appearing to be in a position of prayer. Another figure is leaning forward towards the center where a small child is surrounded by other figures that seem to be animals. In the background, there is a wooden structure resembling a barn or stable with a large star above it in the sky. The scene is set against a backdrop of cross-hatching creating texture and depth, with archways and architecture visible in a shaded setting.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene taking place under a thatched roof with a visible star through it. The composition shows an assembly of various figures, both seated and standing, in a confined space. The figures in the foreground are interacting with one another. Fine lines and intricate details are used throughout the drawing, especially evident in the rendering of the figures' attire and the pattern of the roofing. The drawing reflects a historical setting, indicated by the style of clothing and architectural elements present.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting figures engaged in a ceremony or gathering under a radiant, celestial object. The image shows characters in elaborate, medieval-like garments conversing in the lower half, while a large, luminous circular form with beams emanating outward captures their attention. The intricate details of the figures' attire and the patterned floor contribute to the scene. The play of light and texture emphasizes the scene's atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathering around a table. The scene is composed using intricate lines and shading, creating a highly detailed depiction of several figures huddled closely together. The figures appear cloaked in robes and hats. The setting is indoors, likely within a stone or brick-walled structure. The use of hatch lines enhances the shadow and depth. The composition is tightly knit.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut style illustration of a pastoral landscape. It shows rugged hills with a castle on top near the horizon. In the foreground, travelers interact with donkeys amidst lush foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black against a beige background, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a gothic architectural setting. The drawing features intricate line work and shading, capturing a scene with several figures in an interior space surrounded by tall arches and columns. One figure is positioned centrally and appears to be reading or inspecting an open book, while others are engaged in either discussion or observation around a central pillar. The architectural elements add a sense of depth and texture to the composition, enhancing the dramatic and contemplative atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to block): 7.2 × 4.6 cm (2 13/16 × 1 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central figure surrounded by light rays. Additional figures in various positions are depicted around them. The central figure stands prominently emitting rays outward. It is positioned on a raised platform, and several other figures are shown around it in different poses. Two figures above appear somewhat merged within the radiant background, seemingly interacting with the central figure. The drawing is in a detailed, monochrome style emphasizing the characters and their postures.

artworks.title: Christ Taking Leave of his Mother
artworks.description: This is a detailed woodcut print of a biblical scene showing multiple figures engaging in interaction. The central figure stands as others gather around, with a natural outdoor setting including trees in the background. The style resembles early Renaissance engravings, with dense lines and intricate details capturing the flow of robes and texture of foliage. The focus is on the interaction within the group, conveying a sense of narrative through their gestures and expressions.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered under an archway. The scene includes several figures surrounded by foliage under the shelter of the brick archway. The figures are detailed with exaggerated poses and expressions. The archway's bricks are neatly aligned, framing the activity below. The drawing features rich contrast and intricate cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated around a table in an interior setting. The image depicts a gathering in what appears to be a vaulted room with a large, diamond-paned window at the back. The focus of the scene is the central figure who is highlighted by a radiant halo or light emanating from behind their head. Around the table, various objects such as plates, cups, and small loaves of bread are visible. A basket sits on the floor in the foreground. Linear and cross-hatched textures lend the drawing a sense of depth and intricacy, characteristic of a woodcut print style.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a robed figure in a natural setting among reclining figures, with a landscape of trees and a crescent moon in the sky. Above the central figure, an apparition or face appears among swirling clouds. The artwork uses intricate line work and shading to create contrast, mystery, and reverence. The textures and patterns used suggest an etching or woodcut technique.
